# EXPLORATORY robustness analyses (machine-generated by `python -m pbi stats`; do not edit)

Added after the independent review (`REVIEW.md`). **Not preregistered; they do not replace any verdict in `hypotheses.md`.** Same split halves, 1000 stimulus subsamples, 10,000 permutations and Holm over 9 cells as the primary analysis. Full rows: `artifacts/results/robustness.csv`; per-model variant scores: `artifacts/results/scores_variants.csv`. Definitions: see the docstring of `pbi/robustness.py`.

## Verdicts under each variant (exploratory)

| Variant | H1 | H2 | H5 | H6 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| rsa_cc: RSA on column-centred RDMs (1 - cosine of column-centred features) replaces the RSA cells | PASS (confirmed in 9/9 cells) | FAIL (confirmed datasets: mknn 0/3, CKA 0/3, RSA 0/3) | PASS (mutual k-NN: confirmed in 3/3 datasets) | PASS (upper CI < 1 in 9/9 cells) |
| mknn_chance: chance-adjusted mutual k-NN ((x-c)/(1-c) on score and ceiling, c = k/(n-1)) replaces the mutual k-NN cells | FAIL (confirmed in 6/9 cells) | FAIL (confirmed datasets: mknn 0/3, CKA 0/3, RSA 0/3) | PASS (mutual k-NN: confirmed in 2/3 datasets) | PASS (upper CI < 1 in 9/9 cells) |
| both: both replacements | PASS (confirmed in 9/9 cells) | FAIL (confirmed datasets: mknn 0/3, CKA 0/3, RSA 0/3) | PASS (mutual k-NN: confirmed in 3/3 datasets) | PASS (upper CI < 1 in 9/9 cells) |

## H2 on the layer-selected secondary representation

The preregistration names a secondary representation: the best of 5 depth-fraction layers (0.2-1.0), selected on one random half of the stimuli and scored (noise-ceiling corrected) on the other half. H2 was not preregistered on it; this is the same test applied post hoc. Trained vision models with a layer sweep only (AlexNet was not swept). p = one-sided model-label permutation, Holm over 9 cells; CI = model bootstrap (no stimulus-subsample CI exists here). 'depth-1.0 layer' = the last swept layer scored on the same held-out half, for comparison.

| Dataset | Metric | n | best-layer rho | model-bootstrap 95% CI | p | p (Holm) | confirmed | depth-1.0 layer rho |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Mutual k-NN chance floor

Chance for raw mutual k-NN is c = k/(n-1). After the preregistered correction (raw / sqrt(ceiling)) chance sits at c / sqrt(ceiling), not at 0, so corrected mutual k-NN values are not comparable across datasets and '1.0 = ceiling' does not mean '0 = chance'.

| Dataset | chance c | ceiling range | chance in corrected units (mean over subjects) |
|---|---|---|---|
| EEG | 0.0503 | 0.229 - 0.488 | 0.084 |
| MEG | 0.0503 | 0.058 - 0.123 | 0.183 |
| fMRI | 0.0505 | 0.082 - 0.172 | 0.146 |

## Brain-brain reference, like-for-like

`REF_brain_heldout` in `hypotheses.md` compares a subject's *full* kernel with the mean of the other subjects, while models are scored against *split halves*; that inflates the reference. The like-for-like versions below score the subject's split halves, exactly as models are scored.

| Dataset | Metric | full vs group mean (as in hypotheses.md) | halves vs group mean | halves vs one other subject | best model (primary) |

| EEG | cka | 0.855 | 0.789 | 0.631 | 0.275 |
| EEG | rsa | 0.801 | 0.749 | 0.588 | 0.237 |
| MEG | mknn | 0.289 | 0.255 | 0.223 | 0.258 |
| MEG | cka | 0.444 | 0.272 | 0.159 | 0.234 |
